shader_source_checkout.note: CMake fetches the pinned glslang and SPIRV-Cross repositories directly; the Diligent graphics engine is not linked.

imgui_dx12_backend.note: Matches the vendored D2GL ImGui version; texture IDs use 64 bits for the x86 D3D12 descriptor ABI.

optional_asset_verification.note: Used only to read the existing MPQ shader assets for compiler tests; not part of the game runtime.
